parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the wall cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the outer box.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and door, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items such as dishes or books.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.
